lines.text: God tells Ezekiel to speak to Pharaoh king of Egypt and points him to Assyria, a cedar in Lebanon.
The waters and deep springs made the cedar grow tall, and all the great nations lived in its shade.
No tree in the garden of Eden could compare with its beauty, but it grew proud of its height.
Foreigners cut the cedar down, and the birds of the air nested among the mountains.
God made the nations quake at the cedar's downfall and told Pharaoh he too would be brought down.
